File: Closing MusicCraft stops its server. The Mac must stay awake and connected.
Datoteka: Zapiranje MusicCraft ustavi strežnik. Mac mora ostati buden in povezan.

File: Guide: Space plays or pauses; Left and Right seek five seconds. The order icon cycles sequence, random tracks and random albums. Repeat repeats one track. Double-click a filtered result to start that selection. Click a track beside the vinyl to play it.
Datoteka: Preslednica predvaja ali ustavi, puščici preskočita pet sekund. Ikona vrstnega reda menja zaporedje, naključne skladbe in albume. Ponavljanje velja za skladbo. Dvoklik začne filtrirani rezultat. Za predvajanje kliknite skladbo ob plošči.

File: Guide: add folders or mounted NAS volumes from File. Select a source to listen only to its tracks; All music includes every source. Double-click a track to play.
Datoteka: Dodajte mape ali priklopljene nosilce NAS v meniju Datoteka. Izbira vira omeji poslušanje na njegove skladbe; Vsa glasba vključuje vse vire. Dvoklik predvaja.

File: Guide: artwork is read first from tags, then the album folder, then online. Optional saving adds an image only when no album artwork file exists. Existing images and audio tags are preserved.
Datoteka: Ovitek se išče v oznakah, mapi albuma in na spletu. Izbirno shranjevanje doda le manjkajočo sliko. Obstoječe slike in oznake ostanejo nespremenjene.

File: Guide: automatic synchronization adds new tracks when sources are reachable. The refresh icon forces a complete check. Existing music files are never rewritten or deleted by synchronization.
Datoteka: Samodejna sinhronizacija dodaja nove skladbe dosegljivih virov. Ikona osvežitve sproži celoten pregled. Glasbenih datotek ne prepisuje ali briše.

File: Guide: choose a device and shared or exclusive output in Settings. Exclusive bypasses software volume and ReplayGain. Strict integer stops on incompatible formats. ReplayGain and preamp apply to the next shared-mode track.
Datoteka: V nastavitvah izberite napravo in deljeni ali izključni izhod. Izključni obide programsko glasnost in ReplayGain. Strogi integer zavrne nezdružljive formate. ReplayGain in predojačenje veljata od naslednje deljene skladbe.

File: Guide: enter the phone FTP address, port and music folder, then your credentials. Enable automatic discovery when its IP changes. Keep the phone server running on the same network.
Datoteka: Vnesite naslov FTP telefona, vrata, glasbeno mapo in prijavne podatke. Ob spremembah IP vključite samodejno iskanje. Strežnik telefona mora delovati v istem omrežju.

File: Guide: select a source and start integrated multiroom in Settings. Choose MusicCraft or the displayed Mac IP in piCorePlayer. Select a room, play the source and group other rooms. Keep MusicCraft open and the Mac awake. New tracks appear automatically after source synchronization.
Datoteka: Izberite vir in v nastavitvah zaženite vgrajeni multiroom. V piCorePlayer izberite MusicCraft ali prikazani IP. Izberite sobo, predvajajte vir in združite druge sobe. MusicCraft in Mac naj ostaneta aktivna. Nove skladbe se samodejno pojavijo po sinhronizaciji vira.

File: Guide: the artist biography follows the interface language, with English fallback. Lyrics keep their original language. Timed lyrics follow playback; click a line to seek. Retry repeats a failed lookup.
Datoteka: Biografija sledi jeziku vmesnika, z angleščino kot rezervo. Besedila ostanejo izvirna. Sinhronizirano besedilo sledi predvajanju; klik vrstice preskoči nanjo. Poskusi znova ponovi neuspešno iskanje.

File: Guide: the mini player keeps its size between tabs. Settings controls the global theme, language, 100–130% zoom and reduced animation. F1 opens this guide in both views.
Datoteka: Mini ohrani velikost med zavihki. Nastavitve upravljajo temo, jezik, povečavo 100–130% in manj animacij. F1 odpre priročnik v obeh pogledih.

File: MusicCraft includes the server and manages its settings. Start it, then select MusicCraft as the server in piCorePlayer.
Datoteka: MusicCraft vsebuje in nastavi strežnik. Zaženite ga in v piCorePlayer kot strežnik izberite MusicCraft.

File: No matching artist biography found on Wikipedia.
Datoteka: V Wikipediji ni ustrezne biografije izvajalca.

File: Server ready · automatic player discovery enabled
Datoteka: Strežnik pripravljen · samodejno odkrivanje predvajalnikov vključeno

File: The integrated server connects piCorePlayer and Squeezelite without a separate installation.
Datoteka: Vgrajeni strežnik poveže piCorePlayer in Squeezelite brez ločene namestitve.

File: Guide: shuffle tracks plays the listening selection without repeats. Only started tracks count. Previous, manual choices and Repeat track can replay tracks. A new source or selection starts a new cycle; closing the app and changing order mode keep it.
Datoteka: Naključne skladbe predvaja izbor brez ponavljanja. Štejejo samo začete skladbe. Prejšnja, ročna izbira in Ponovi skladbo omogočajo ponovno poslušanje. Drug vir ali izbor začne nov cikel; zaprtje aplikacije in sprememba vrstnega reda ga ohranita.

File: Guide: both player views remember their own sizes after restart. On a smaller display they fit the usable area with a 24-point margin, preserving the preferred size for larger displays.
Datoteka: Oba pogleda po ponovnem zagonu ohranita svoje mere. Na manjšem zaslonu se prilagodita uporabni površini z robom 24 točk in ohranita želeno velikost za večje zaslone.

File: Drag to adjust volume; hold Shift for fine control. Scroll or use arrow keys for small changes.
Datoteka: Povlecite za nastavitev glasnosti; držite Shift za natančno nastavitev. Za majhne spremembe uporabite drsenje ali puščice.
